sections.content: You know the *pretérito indefinido* and the *imperfecto* from A2 Units 11 and 21, *antes de* and *después de* + infinitive from A2 Unit 4 and the *pluscuamperfecto* from B1 Unit 1. This lesson puts them together in one connected story: the *pluscuamperfecto* marks what happened before the main line, and the *indefinido* carries the story forward.

items.spanish: Cuando llegué, ya había empezado la reunión.
items.english: When I arrived, the meeting had already started.

items.spanish: Después de hablar con ellos, cambié de opinión.
items.english: After speaking with them, I changed my mind.

items.spanish: Al principio no sabía qué hacer, pero con el tiempo encontré una solución.
items.english: At first I didn't know what to do, but over time I found a solution.

sections.content: The *pluscuamperfecto* (*había empezado*) marks what happened before the main story line, while the *indefinido* (*cambié*) moves the story forward. Together they let you tell a story out of strict order.
